reviews.author: Cynthia
reviews.text: Husband and I fell for the trap. Multiple locations across Glasgow, thousands of glowing Google reviews, sky-high ratings… so we thought “surely this can’t be mid.” We were wrong. I ordered the tonkatsu ramen. The broth was so salty it felt like it was actively trying to raise my blood pressure on the spot. The meat was tough, dry, and somehow both flavourless and offensive at the same time. Husband went for the Hell Ramen, expecting actual heat. What he got was a mild, vaguely peppery soup that wouldn’t even make a toddler sweat. Zero kick. Just disappointment with a side of black pepper. The portions were tiny. Laughably small amounts of actual food floating in oversized bowls that looked impressive until you realised half of it was empty space and the other half was salt water. Optical illusion ramen. The greatest magic trick Glasgow has ever pulled. Service did the absolute bare minimum. No warmth, no effort, just the functional delivery of two underwhelming bowls and a quiet hope that we’d leave soon. We left disappointed, still hungry, and slightly betrayed by every single 5-star review that lured us in. If this is what thousands of people are raving about, the bar for ramen in Glasgow is lying on the floor. 2 stars. One for the fact they managed to put noodles in a bowl, and one for the pure comedy of calling that broth “Hell.” Never again.

reviews.author: Martin Saliu-Yusuf
reviews.text: We had a fantastic evening overall. The food was really enjoyable, and the cocktails were honestly some of the best I’ve ever had. The restaurant has lovely decor and a great feel to it, making it a nice place to spend an evening. We visited on a Saturday night and were seated straight away, with quick service throughout. A special mention goes to Bing, who was an absolute pleasure. She was welcoming, attentive and consistently friendly, with a warm smile that made us feel genuinely looked after. She went above and beyond to ensure all our needs were met. I particularly appreciated how attentive she was, checking in at the right moments and asking whether we wanted to order anything else rather than leaving us to constantly catch someone’s attention. It’s those little details that make such a difference to the dining experience. The service from the entire team was brilliant, and Bing deserves particular recognition for the warmth and professionalism she brought to the evening. My only criticism would be the seating arrangements, as some tables are quite close together, which can make the dining experience feel a little cramped. We also had to move seats initially as we were directly underneath the air conditioning. However, these were relatively minor inconveniences in what was otherwise a very enjoyable evening. Overall, a great experience, fantastic cocktails and excellent customer service. Bing is a real credit to the restaurant, and I’ll definitely be coming back!

Our appetizers arrived after the main courses, which is hard to explain given how quiet the restaurant was. The service was friendly. Unfortunately, the price was also difficult to justify. (Original) Das Essen war leider nicht mehr als durchschnittlich - ich denke das lässt sich leicht toppen. Unsere Vorspeisen kamen leider erst nach dem Hauptspeisen, was bei wenig Betrieb wenig erklärbar ist. Der Service war nett. Preislich leider auch nur schwer zu vertreten.

reviews.author: Veronica Hamid
reviews.text: Food and atmosphere were excellent. The food came to the table all separately with some of the group having finished when the other food came out. Several times chasing for the food. Kitchen staff should plan meal readiness times more adequately to ensure all food comes out together.

reviews.author: anni d
reviews.text: Quingxuan L was a very helpful and friendly server! Great first experience

reviews.author: Diane Davies
reviews.text: Carlos was amazing. Great service. Delicious food. My friend tried Sashimi for the first time and loved it.

reviews.author: Luca Fiume
reviews.text: An absolutely wonderful experience! The sushi was incredibly fresh and delicious, with every dish beautifully prepared and full of flavour. What made the evening even more special was the owner’s outstanding hospitality. He was genuinely kind and welcoming, took the time to explain the different dishes and their ingredients, and even treated us to complimentary drinks and a delicious soup. It’s rare to find such a combination of excellent food, personal attention and genuine Japanese hospitality. You really feel that the owner cares about his guests and takes pride in what he does. Highly recommended! I will definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: Cheng Adah
reviews.text: Food was delicious. Service was really great. Ginger and Jada were over the top! Super friendly!

reviews.author: Adam Usmani
reviews.text: Excellent meal! We really enjoyed the selection of hand rolls and also the Omakase. Everything was really fresh and full of flavour. We also got a few hot plates too which were great. The service was exceptional. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a Japanese meal!

reviews.author: ccgyozalover
reviews.text: 🥢Crudo – Scallop & Akami 🍣 Hand Rolls – Negitoro, Hamachi & Snow Crab 🥩 Premium Nigiri – A5 Wagyu & Chutoro 🍱 Tokusei 15pcs Chef’s Selection ⭐️ The hand rolls were definitely the star of the show! Each one is made to order and served immediately, giving you that perfectly crisp, freshly rolled nori with every bite. The combination of sushi rice, fresh toppings and crunchy nori was just 👌 Beyond the hand rolls, Maki Nori also has a great selection of crudo and premium nigiri, with high-quality ingredients that really speak for themselves.

reviews.author: Nathan Fernandes
reviews.text: Fake Aesop in the bathroom, room temperature sushi, and Instagram flair. No I don’t want dry ice smoke effect with my sushi. At least it was cheap.
